name: quality-without-predicted-class replication
scope: Prospectively fixed followup of a posthoc finding; not a replacement primary analysis or independent human replication.
internal_cohort: original 2085-record PTB-XL final test set; reused for seed sensitivity, not untouched validation
development: same architecture/optimizer/early-stopping recipe; clean folds1-6 train, fold7 checkpoint and AF cutoff, fold8 rankers, unlabeled fold9 policies; no outcome-based model selection
checkpoint_gate: AUROC>=0.8 and specificity>=0.5 at 90% checkpoint sensitivity
ranker_gate: at least30 participants with wrong variants and30 with correct variants
noise: unchanged NSTDB em seconds1200-1780 and deterministic assignment; previously used noise library, not a fresh artifact-source validation
fixed_policy: 90% weighted score quantile on unlabeled fold9; no external or test retuning
primary_effect: Mean over em24/12/6/0 of balanced retained error(candidate) minus balanced retained error(original quality ranker)
interval: 2000 paired bootstrap resamples, seed20261030; internal by participant, external by record because patient linkage unavailable; same draw across all severities
sample_size_gate: At least30 AF-positive and30 non-AF units (participants internally, records externally) or no numerical comparison interval
replication_rule: All two fresh-seed internal comparisons AND all three seed-specific fresh-external comparisons must have negative pointwise95% interval upper bounds and candidate AF retention>=80% at every primary noisy condition. Also report unfiltered/raw-confidence performance; passing this rule is not clinical validation.

external.selection: lowest SHA256(seed|path), excluding all original2000 sampled headers before inspecting new headers; no replacement for ineligibility or failures
external.decoder: unchanged physical leadII and resample_poly1/5 Kaiser5 constant padding
external.exact_waveform_overlap: Stop on exact duplicate within new sample or overlap with previous external sample/PTBXL cohorts; do not silently remove or replace
external.patient_linkage: Provider record identifiers do not establish distinct patients; record bootstrap assumes record independence and may understate uncertainty
